reference: Original GGML constructors, actual original one-thread CPU graphs, unchanged native outputs captured before Rust implementation/comparison.
notes: IM2COL_BACK CPU input order is gradient then kernel metadata; header comments reverse these names.
IM2COL 1D/2D uses flattened IH*IW addresses within each channel, including original padded-row behavior; 3D uses source strides.
Pool1D excludes padding from average divisor; Pool2D includes padding in the full kernel-area divisor.
Pool2D fractional padding affects constructor output dimensions, then is truncated into I32 operator parameters for kernel addressing.
Pool max initializes -FLT_MAX and uses source comparator argument order. Backward uses source first-tie and NaN comparison order.
Native output byte strides before CONT are retained as the last four case integers, including CWHN depthwise outputs.
Raw payload and exceptional cases preserve original output bytes; no normalization or numerical tolerance is applied.
Compiler/macro provenance matches the prior indexing and row-math references. Both frozen builds omit GGML_SIMD/SSE3 and use F64 scalar F32/F16 channel dots.
